summary: Five exact-hash documents form a coherent proposed contract for approved PRD F-01–18. UX covers journeys, errors, permissions, accessibility and the assistant-ui/tool-ui boundary; architecture distinguishes app contracts from unverified native capability and defines state, API, path, security, idempotency and recovery boundaries; verification specifies success/failure and observable effects for every AC; operations defines local release, rollback, diagnostics and personal metrics; index preserves traceability, ownership and approval holds. S-01–10, platform choice, visual values, Figma access and product release remain expressly dependent on later evidence and authorization. This document gate does not attest implemented UI, SDK, OS security or live runtime behavior.
